products.name: InSet Anatomic Total Shoulder Arthroplasty (aTSA) System
products.description: Anatomic total shoulder arthroplasty system built around the InSet Glenoid technology designed to address glenoid loosening, the primary failure mode in legacy aTSA implants.
products.regulatory_status: FDA 510(k) cleared; commercially marketed in the U.S.

products.name: InSet Reverse Total Shoulder Arthroplasty (rTSA) System
products.description: Reverse total shoulder arthroplasty system leveraging InSet Glenoid and InSet humeral stem technologies.
products.regulatory_status: FDA 510(k) cleared; commercially marketed in the U.S.

products.name: ProVoyance Preoperative Planning Technology
products.description: AI/ML-enabled preoperative planning software that converts planar CT imaging into 3D renderings for patient-specific surgical planning.

products.name: Two-Tray Efficient Instrument System
products.description: Two-tray instrument system supporting both aTSA and rTSA procedures, reducing operating-room footprint vs. legacy six-to-nine tray systems.
products.regulatory_status: Commercially marketed with the InSet implant ecosystem.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Pure orthopedic medical-device company (shoulder arthroplasty implants and surgical planning software). Products are FDA 510(k) cleared and commercialized; no active proprietary drug pipeline and no active company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 clinical drug trials. The 10-K describes a post-market clinical registry (2/5/10-year follow-up) for adoption support rather than an interventional pivotal trial program.
